scientific_integrity: Earlier minimum-cardinality results are acknowledged; the claim concerns exhaustive optimum-solution geometry, counting and single-token exchanges. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for even n>=8 and odd n>=13; finite checker complements rather than replaces the proof. Related 2006, 2008 and 2012 primary full texts were not all accessible, leaving risk of equivalent prior classification.
title: Parity, a resonant exception, and token exchanges among minimum identifying codes of cycles
